main.py: EyeControlSystem accepts injected eye_tracker and mouse_controller, retaining original defaults.
Optional on_frame callback runs immediately after each camera read in both calibration and main loops.
Removed M key and console instructions; only C and Q, including uppercase, remain.
Q during calibration exits the application without fitting partial calibration.
Closing the original native windows exits cleanly; calibration read failures still process Q/window-close events.
Right-click invocation uses the injected mouse controller instead of bypassing it.
Camera initialization honors the existing camera_index setting with the original default of 0.
eye_tracker.py: Added _map_normalized(feat), defaulting exactly to feat @ self.poly_matrix.
Both existing polynomial prediction sites use this hook; all original feature extraction, fitting, smoothing, blink and mouth code preserved.
mouse_controller.py: Copied original methods unchanged; added right_click() forwarding exactly to pyautogui.rightClick() so the FPGA subclass can gate the call.
